# CINEK — artist universe

This project mirrors the broad information architecture of Claudia.gallery: artist identity, music and films, looks/visual canon, a production wiki, searchable records, public JSON and an agent-facing MCP interface.

## Verified source hub
https://linktr.ee/noahcinek

The Linktree identifies itself as Cinek and lists TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Apple Music, Spotify and Facebook, plus Our Song, Floating (Genom Världar - English Version), EMPTY BED collaboration, Genom Världar original and acoustic versions.

## Catalogue status
The initial catalogue is seeded with track titles found in public music catalogue sources. The site intentionally routes to the official Linktree until exact direct track/video URLs are verified.

## Permissions
Do not claim artist endorsement, authorization, open-character status, permission to use the artist's likeness/music, or an official token relationship unless the artist or rights holder has explicitly approved it.

## API
See /api/index.json, /api/songs.json, /api/socials.json and /api/wiki.json.

## MCP
A read-only MCP-compatible JSON-RPC endpoint is exposed at /mcp. Tools: search_catalog, get_artist, list_songs, list_links, list_wiki.
